latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of cross-platform-memory.

- Injects recent Telegram and Discord user conversations into the OpenClaw gateway session context.
- Enables agents to remember and reference conversations across Telegram, Discord, and other OpenClaw channels for improved context continuity.
- Reads from session logs, local MEMORY.md, and daily notes; filters and tags messages by platform.
- Limits to the most recent 8 messages per platform and filters out bot messages.
- Configurable via environment variables and easy integration with mission-control and chat APIs.
- Falls back to long-term and daily memory files if no session logs are present.
